info.title: CardioWatch AI API
info.description: From Cardiac Monitoring Data to Better Clinical Awareness and Care-Team Coordination. Proof of concept on SYNTHETIC data only — not a medical device.

post.description: Ask the connected virtual-care platform to open a video consult for this alarm (integration outbox event).

get.description: Product templates: what each device type measures (LOINC/UCUM), which alarm rules apply, when it counts as offline.
Fleet of devices assigned to currently monitored patients, with derived connectivity/battery health.
Recompute the audit hash chain; any edited or deleted entry breaks it.
Deceased vs. discharged-alive comparison across age, disease, treatment, medication, unit and alarm burden.

Cohort explorer. Filters: age_group, pathology, medication_class, treatment, unit, alarm_type,
severity, hour (repeatable). Reference cohort: same names prefixed with `ref_`; default = all
monitored patients with the same alarm-type/severity/hour filters.
Engineering assistant: answers only from approved, authorized records, with citations.

post.description: Show the automatic classification and redaction before submitting.

put.description: Edits create a new version; approved knowledge goes back to review (no silent changes to guidance).

post.description: Record that a feature applied this knowledge (the compounding signal).

get.description: Live permission matrix from the server's source of truth (app/auth.py).
Simple, non-clinical engagement messages (no diagnosis, no medication advice).
